verdict.rationale: Temporal's docs say failed Activities retry automatically by default, so transient failures need no handling code. A configurable Retry Policy controls how and when to retry, and the platform takes over failure handling from application code. A hands-on user independently confirms that any unit retries easily and that specific errors can be marked non-retryable. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of configurable backoff parameters (interval/coefficient/max attempts), evidence of Activity/Workflow timeout configuration.
